sloka: न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः ।न च सर्वे रणे शक्ता रामं प्रतिसमासितुम् ।। ५.६७.२० ।।।।
transliteration: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ ।na ca sarve raṇe śaktā rāmaṁ pratisamāsitum ।। 5.67.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "— let Ravana be slain swiftly in battle with keen shafts; or let Lakshmana, scorcher of foes, receive his brother's command.
